abstract: Seventy-Two patients with stage I testicular non-seminoma presenting between January 1984 and December 1988 were managed either by adjuvant chemotherapy in the presence of histological adverse prognostic factors or by surveillance if none of these factors were present. The determining factors were vascular invasion, lymphatic invasion, involvement of the epididymis, involvement of the rete testis. Thirty patients were treated with three courses of platinum, vinblastine and bleomycin (PVB) and 42 were managed by surveillance. All 72 patients are alive and have been free of disease from 12-60+ months. One of 42 patients managed by surveillance relapsed 16 months after orchidectomy and he has been disease-free for 32+ months after chemotherapy. No relapses occurred in patients treated with adjuvant chemotherapy. The results confirm the suggestion by Peckham (Hoskin et al., 1986) that histopathological analysis of the primary tumour can provide the basis for subsequent management either by surveillance or chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 病期I精巣非セミノーマ72例を、1984年1月から1988年12月にかけて治療された患者で検討した。組織学的な不良因子(血管侵襲、リンパ管侵襲、精巣上体への浸潤、精巣網への浸潤)が認められた場合は補助化学療法を、これらの因子が認められない場合は経過観察を行った。30例はPVB療法3コースを、42例は経過観察を受けた。72例全例が生存し、12～60か月以上無病であった。経過観察群の42例中1例は、精巣摘除後16か月で再発したが、化学療法後32か月以上無病であった。補助化学療法を受けた患者では再発は認められなかった。本結果は、Peckham(Hoskin et al., 1986)の示唆を裏付けるものであり、原発腫瘍の組織病理学的解析が経過観察か化学療法かの治療方針の決定に基礎を提供しうることを示している。
